WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.

4. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.

5. When learning Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.

6. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

7. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.

8. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of timber trees.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Growth of timber trees.

9. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. When learning Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
